title: Read together, first letter
note: Chrome-free, Large print by default: one letter at a time, oldest first. The dateline reads "The first weeks · From Mama" (VoiceOver: "The first weeks, from Mama"); a 2 pt hairline under the top bar shows how far along, never "1 / 5". A "Hear Mama" pill plays the recording on the phone. Read together is free for every letter that exists, with no session limit (D-082, D-083). (Seeded family Asha. Playback itself is native audio and is not exercised on web.)
text: Close The first weeks · From Mama Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep. From Mama Hear Mama 0:42 Keep playing Back one Next letter
